name: ReceivePlayerSpawnPointMsg
summary: A 4-byte record that is the typed envelope and nothing else, so its body is empty. It arrives at seq 0x07, after registration and before level info, and tells the client its spawn point is known.
purpose: Signal that the client's spawn point has been resolved, which is what rung 16 (WaitingForSpawnPoint) is waiting for. A message with no body is a signal rather than data, so the whole record is the name.

created_when: the server has resolved where the client should spawn, after registration and before level info
lifecycle.if_absent: unknown; the rung it sits under is named WaitingForSpawnPoint, so its absence is a candidate for a client that never leaves that rung. Not measured: no run has withheld it while holding everything else constant

fields.name: typed_header
fields.note: Measured 00 01 91 19. The prefix varint 91 19 is 1617 = 0x651, which is the whole record: there is no body to lay out.

NOT the rung-15 transition. STATUS.md records that the actor game connection reaching state 2 leaves rung 15, and this record arrives after registration at the same rung as a notification. Sending it does not substitute for the Carrier transport work
